title: Eddie Kingston’s Continental Classic redemption
summary: Kingston risks his existing championships in a tournament that ends with a victory over his old friend.

chapters.title: Kingston wins the inaugural Classic
chapters.result: Kingston defeats Moxley to secure the Continental Crown.
chapters.context: The tournament brings together AEW, ROH, and NJPW championship stakes.

chapters.title: Kingston earns Danielson’s respect
chapters.result: Kingston defeats Danielson and receives a post-match handshake.
chapters.context: Their title match also resolves a personal dispute over respect.
